info.title: PitchPadi API
info.description: Football pitch booking for Lagos. Errors are always `{ error, fieldErrors? }`. Money is in kobo (integer). Times are ISO 8601 UTC; local labels use the facility time zone.

get.summary: Service and database health. status "outdated" means database migrations are pending (run npm run db:migrate)
get.description: No sign-in required.

post.summary: Send a 6-digit sign-in code by SMS. Same answer whether or not the number has an account. 429 (with Retry-After) during the resend cooldown or past hourly limits. devCode appears only in development
post.description: No sign-in required.

post.summary: Check the code and sign in, creating the account on first use. Starts a fresh session (any previous one in this browser or app ends). The website gets a cookie; the app (client: app) gets a bearer token in the body; PitchPadi Admin (client: admin, team members only) gets a 12-hour admin cookie. 403 for a blocked account, or a number not on the team when client is admin
post.description: No sign-in required.

sessionToken.description: Only when client is app: send as Authorization: Bearer. Keep in secure storage

post.summary: Sign out on every device
post.description: Requires a signed-in user.

post.summary: Sign out and clear the session cookie
post.description: No sign-in required.

get.summary: Signed-in user and their organizations
get.description: Requires a signed-in user.

get.summary: The signed-in player's bookings. inProgress: live holds and open payments they started while signed in (to return to checkout), soonest to expire first. upcoming/past: confirmed bookings paid for while signed in or booked with their verified phone number; upcoming soonest first, then the 20 most recent past games
get.description: Requires a signed-in user.

post.summary: Get notifications on this phone (new bookings for venue members; booking confirmations and kick-off reminders for players). Tied to this session: signing out stops them. Safe to repeat
post.description: Requires a signed-in user.

post.summary: Stop notifications on this phone. Safe to repeat
post.description: Requires a signed-in user.

get.summary: Active Lagos areas
get.description: No sign-in required.

post.summary: Set up a venue: the business, its first facility and a private pitch. The venue starts pending PitchPadi review and cannot publish until approved
post.description: Requires a signed-in user.

post.summary: Ask PitchPadi to review a rejected venue again
post.description: Requires the organization's owner.

get.summary: Organization and the caller's role
get.description: Requires an owner or staff member of the organization.

get.summary: One local day of bookings (with customer contact) and live holds (labelled, no customer) across the organization's pitches
get.description: Requires an owner or staff member of the organization.

post.summary: Record a phone, WhatsApp or walk-in booking. Blocks the time exactly like an online booking; 409 if anything is in the way. Repeating the same Idempotency-Key returns the same booking (200)
post.description: Requires an owner or staff member of the organization.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. A random key the client keeps for this booking and reuses on retry, so a lost response never records it twice.

get.summary: Standard price, opening-hours check and anything already in the way, for the manual booking form. Saves nothing
get.description: Requires an owner or staff member of the organization.

post.summary: Mark a venue-entered booking as paid (cash, POS or transfer)
post.description: Requires an owner or staff member of the organization.

post.summary: Cancel a venue-entered booking before it ends, freeing the time. Online bookings are not cancelled here
post.description: Requires an owner or staff member of the organization.

get.summary: Facilities with their pitches
get.description: Requires an owner or staff member of the organization.

post.summary: Create a facility with its first pitch
post.description: Requires the organization's owner.

get.summary: One facility
get.description: Requires the organization's owner.

patch.summary: Edit facility details, address and landmark

put.summary: Set or clear the venue's map pin (players see distance and exact directions). Must be inside Lagos

post.summary: Add a pitch to a facility. 409 if the facility already has a pitch with that name (so a retried request never makes two)
post.description: Requires the organization's owner.

get.summary: One pitch
get.description: Requires the organization's owner.

get.summary: Hours, prices and policy for the editor
get.description: Requires the organization's owner.

put.summary: Replace weekly hours, prices and policy

get.summary: Closures that have not finished yet, soonest first
get.description: Requires an owner or staff member of the organization.

post.summary: Close a pitch for whole days or part of one day, so players cannot book it. 409 (with the games' times, no player details) if a booking or live hold is in the way
post.description: Requires an owner or staff member of the organization.

delete.description: Requires an owner or staff member of the organization.

get.summary: The venue's photos, cover first
get.description: Requires an owner or staff member of the organization.

post.summary: Add a photo: the body is the image itself (JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 8 MB, at least 400 px on the short side). It is re-encoded without metadata into two WebP sizes. 409 at the venue's photo limit (3)
post.description: Requires the organization's owner.

post.summary: Make a photo the cover, shown on search cards
post.description: Requires the organization's owner.

get.summary: The venue's owners and staff
get.description: Requires the organization's owner.

post.summary: Add a staff member by phone number. They see the venue the next time they sign in with that number. 409 if already on the team
post.description: Requires the organization's owner.

delete.summary: Take a staff member off the venue (owners cannot be removed)

get.summary: Published pitches across Lagos (20 per page)
get.description: No sign-in required.

get.summary: Bookable slots for a date
get.description: No sign-in required.

get.summary: Published pitches across Lagos (or one area) with open start times on a date; 20 per page, open pitches first
get.description: No sign-in required.

schema.description: Game length in minutes. Only pitches with matching open options are returned
Budget in kobo: only lengths that cost at most this
Start times before noon, noon to 5 pm, or from 5 pm (Lagos time)
Open pitches always come first. recommended uses distance when near is given; nearest needs near
lat,lng of the player, rounded by the client to about 1 km. Used only to work out distances; never stored or logged

get.summary: The same search as searchPitches, by venue: each venue once with all its matching pitches; 10 venues per page, venues with something open first
get.description: No sign-in required.

schema.description: Game length in minutes. Only pitches with matching open options are returned
Budget in kobo: only lengths that cost at most this
Start times before noon, noon to 5 pm, or from 5 pm (Lagos time)
Open pitches always come first. recommended uses distance when near is given; nearest needs near
lat,lng of the player, rounded by the client to about 1 km. Used only to work out distances; never stored or logged

get.summary: A venue photo file (development storage only; with a bucket, photo URLs point at the bucket)
get.description: No sign-in required.

get.summary: A venue's public page: its details and every published pitch with open start times on a date (default today)
get.description: No sign-in required.

get.summary: One published pitch with open start times on a date (default today)
get.description: No sign-in required.

get.summary: Book again: the same weekday, kick-off and length over the coming weeks, each open or not, at today's prices
get.description: No sign-in required.

schema.description: The game to repeat (any past or future kick-off)

post.summary: Hold a slot for checkout. The server re-checks the time and sets the price; repeating the same Idempotency-Key returns the same hold (200)
post.description: No sign-in required.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A random key the client keeps for this checkout attempt and reuses on retry.

get.summary: The current state of a hold (expired holds are released first)
get.description: No sign-in required.

delete.summary: Release a live hold so the slot opens again. Safe to repeat; returns the hold's state

get.summary: Recover an existing hold after a lost create response using its private Idempotency-Key
get.description: No sign-in required.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: The private key saved before the original hold request.

post.summary: Record the guest's details and payment method, extend the hold to that method's deadline and open a payment session. A signed-in caller is linked to the booking (My bookings); signing in is optional. Repeating the same Idempotency-Key returns the same session (200)
post.description: No sign-in required.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A random key the client keeps for this checkout attempt and reuses on retry.

post.summary: Payment provider events. The signature is checked against the raw body; duplicates are acknowledged without effect. Only this can confirm a booking
post.description: No sign-in required.

get.summary: A confirmed booking as shared with teammates: the game only, never the guest's details
get.description: No sign-in required.

get.summary: Test mode only: the stand-in provider's checkout page data
get.description: No sign-in required.

post.summary: Test mode only: act as the provider and send a signed success or failure event through the real webhook path
post.description: No sign-in required.

get.summary: Who is signed in to PitchPadi Admin: roles, permissions and what sign-in still needs (authenticator set-up or code)
get.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked.

post.summary: Start setting up an authenticator app: returns the secret and an otpauth:// link to scan. 409 once one is set up
post.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked.

post.summary: Finish authenticator set-up with its first code; the session counts as verified
post.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked.

post.summary: Enter an authenticator code: at sign-in, and again before step-up actions. 429 after 5 wrong codes (15 minutes)
post.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked.

post.summary: Sign out of PitchPadi Admin
post.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked.

get.summary: Totals, a daily chart, what needs attention, growth, busiest hours and areas, and the venue leaderboard, for the last 7, 30 or 90 Lagos days. No personal details
get.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: metrics.read.

get.summary: With q: find bookings and holds by reference (PP-…) or the player's phone number. Without: every booking, latest game first, 25 a page, filtered by game date, status, source and venue. Audited, without a searched phone number
get.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: bookings.read.

get.summary: One booking: its payments, money owed and history. Audited
get.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: bookings.read.

post.summary: Cancel a confirmed game before it starts, on someone's behalf, with a reason. The time is free at once; a game paid online is owed back in full (refund due)
post.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: bookings.act. Needs an authenticator code from the last 15 minutes (403 with code "step_up").

get.summary: Refunds owed (due, oldest first) or already paid back (paid, newest first)
get.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: refunds.read.

post.summary: Record that a refund was paid back, with the Paystack or bank reference. A new ledger entry; the ledger is never edited
post.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: refunds.settle. Needs an authenticator code from the last 15 minutes (403 with code "step_up").

get.summary: Venues by review status (default pending, oldest first), with whether the team has hidden them
get.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: venues.read.

get.summary: Every venue with owner, areas, pitches, photos and the last 30 days' games and value. Waiting for review first. Search by venue, facility or area name
get.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: venues.read.

get.summary: One venue: owner and staff, facilities and pitches with prices and policies, 30-day numbers and chart, latest games and history. Audited
get.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: venues.read.

get.summary: A venue's photos by facility, for moderation
get.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: venues.read.

post.summary: Approve or send back a pending venue. Sending back needs a note for the owner
post.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: venues.review.

post.summary: Hide a venue from players, with a reason. Games already booked stand
post.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: venues.suspend. Needs an authenticator code from the last 15 minutes (403 with code "step_up").

post.summary: Show a hidden venue to players again, with a reason
post.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: venues.suspend. Needs an authenticator code from the last 15 minutes (403 with code "step_up").

post.summary: Remove a venue photo, with a reason
post.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: photos.remove.

get.summary: A venue's audit trail, newest first, optionally for one booking reference. The read itself is audited with the stated reason
get.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: audit.read.

get.summary: Players, venue people and the team, newest first, 25 a page. Filter by kind or part of a phone number. Audited, without the number typed
get.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: users.read.

get.summary: One person: games, spend, venues, team roles and active sign-ins. Audited
get.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: users.read.

get.summary: Every payment attempt, newest first, 25 a page, by status (pending means not yet finished). Audited
get.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: payments.read.

get.summary: The team's own audit trail, newest first, 25 a page: who did what, when and why
get.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: audit.read.

post.summary: Block an account, with a reason: every session ends and sign-in is refused. Team members cannot be blocked
post.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: users.block. Needs an authenticator code from the last 15 minutes (403 with code "step_up").

post.summary: Unblock an account, with a reason
post.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: users.block. Needs an authenticator code from the last 15 minutes (403 with code "step_up").

get.summary: The PitchPadi team and their roles
get.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: team.manage.

post.summary: Give a phone number a team role. They sign in to PitchPadi Admin with it and set up an authenticator
post.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: team.manage. Needs an authenticator code from the last 15 minutes (403 with code "step_up").

delete.summary: Take a team role away. The last admin cannot be removed; with no roles left, their admin sessions end
delete.description: PitchPadi Admin only (ADR-004): an admin-app session with its authenticator code checked. Permission: team.manage. Needs an authenticator code from the last 15 minutes (403 with code "step_up").

get.summary: This OpenAPI document
get.description: No sign-in required.
